title: Eliminating free literal positions
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates whose literal coordinates are pairwise distinct, let $\rho$ assign each coordinate a free or fixed sign state, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Fix, according to the sign encoded by $x$, every coordinate that is free and occurs in $T$. After these coordinates are fixed, no literal of $T$ remains at a free coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF term on $n$ coordinates with pairwise distinct literal coordinates
A coordinate restriction on the $n$ coordinates
